sentences.text:
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:-
 ORDER Petitioner seeks to lay a challenge to the acquisition of the land in question commenced with the issuance of Preliminary Notification dated 11.4.1989 u/s 17(1) followed by the Final Notification dated 22.7.1991 issued u/s 19(1) of the Bangalore Development Authority Act, 1976.

Learned counsel for the Petitioners vehemently argues that though award is stated to have been passed on 10.12.1998, the same is not approved by the government; the possession of the land continues with his clients till date; the question of execution of the scheme within the statutory period even remotely would not arise.
So arguing, he seeks for voiding of the subject Notifications.
2. After service of notice, the State has entered appearance through the learned AGA and the BDA is represented by its Senior Panel Counsel.
They vehemently oppose the Petition making submission in justification of the acquisition proceedings and on the ground that the challenge is belated, there being no explanation therefor.
However, there is neither plea nor proof as to the said award having been approved by the government nor the possession having been taken from the Petitioners.

The reliance of the BDA Panel Counsel on the Mahazar dated 3.12.1998 at Annexure-R2 is misplaced inasmuch as it is not with regard to possession at all but something else, as rightly argued by counsel for the Petitioners.

(b) Learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that no compensation having been paid nor deposited in the Court, despite direction by the award making authority, even after lapse of decades of initiation of the proceedings, the acquisition has to be voided, merits acceptance, there being no controverting of the same from the side of Respondents.
No explanation is offered either for not making the payment of compensation or for not depositing it in the Court.
The Right to Property having been constitutionally guaranteed u/a 300A, the same cannot be taken over by the State and its instrumentalities except in due process of law.
Such a process is militantly lacking in this case.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the Petitioners is more than justified in submitting that the possession having not been taken over, the BDA cannot be heard to say anything about the execution of the scheme within the statutory period.
Once substantial execution of the scheme is not shown, the acquisition has to fail since scheme itself lapses by operation of law.

In the above circumstances, this Writ Petition is allowed; a Writ of Certiorari issues quashing the impugned Notifications only to the extent of Petition lands; if entries are mutated pursuant to acquisition, the same shall be restored in the name of land owners by the jurisdictional authorities on the production of a copy of this judgment, within an outer limit of three months.
Delay if brooked may entail costs personally payable by the lapsing officials.

Costs reluctantly made easy.
